capabilities.name: Controlled Hybrid LLM Rendering Runtime
capabilities.responsibility: Build evidence-locked rendering requests, invoke an injected renderer provider once, parse structured output, apply deterministic fidelity checks, and retain the deterministic explanation as fallback on provider, structure or fidelity failure.
capabilities.authority_role: Reusable controlled candidate-rendering runtime. In the current canonical path its candidate remains subordinate to Rendering Exit Safety and is not the final release authority.
safety_invariants: The deterministic explanation is retained across provider failure, malformed output and fidelity failure.
Provider invocation is bounded by an explicit provider-neutral contract and controlled model policy.
Structured candidates are parsed and fidelity-validated before the legacy runtime marks them rendered.
Canonical customer release still requires the newer Rendering Exit Safety boundary when this runtime is used through the provider-integration bridge.
capabilities.notes: Provider-neutral runtime exists in-repo; no concrete vendor-specific production adapter is claimed by this capability.
